'''June 2000 Tempe tournament (25 June)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Tempe, Arizona on 25 June 2000. [[Michael Girard]] won it. It is known from Michael Girard's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d941">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-26-tempe-az-6-25-00d941/ tempe-az-6-25-00], DeckTech (Michael "Dvader" Girard, 26 June 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-26-tempe-az-6-25-00d941/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 25 June 2000
* '''Site:''' Tempe, Arizona
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Michael Girard]]
